boards.school_name: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo
boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Cal Poly study environments, from reservable-style rooms and collaborative zones to quiet, outdoor, and round-the-clock options.

cards.title: Settle In at Hub24
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Library’s round-the-clock study zone
cards.notes: Use the first or second floor when your work runs beyond regular library hours; bring the Cal Poly credentials required for secure entry.
cards.short_summary: A two-floor option for studying outside standard building hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly states that Hub24 expanded to the first and second floors when Kennedy Library reopened, and the academic catalog describes secure 24/7 access to those floors.
cards.source_title: Light, Spacious and Bustling: Take a Look Inside a Refreshed Kennedy Library
cards.access_notes: Secure 24/7 access covers Kennedy Library’s first and second floors; university affiliation or credentials may be required for secured entry.

cards.entity_name: The Jerry & Sally Holcombe Study Space
cards.title: Spread Out in the Holcombe Study Space
cards.subtitle: A named second-level Kennedy Library study area
cards.notes: Choose this second-floor zone for an indoor work session, and consult the library’s current maps or signs before selecting a seat.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated study destination on Kennedy Library’s second level.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly’s Kennedy Library transformation page identifies The Jerry & Sally Holcombe Study Space as a Level 2 feature.
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 2 of Kennedy Library; follow current library entry rules and posted room guidance.

cards.title: Work Together in the Fishbowls
cards.subtitle: Glass-fronted study spaces on Kennedy Library’s second level
cards.notes: Head to Level 2 when your group needs a defined workspace, then check posted signs or the library system for any use restrictions.
cards.short_summary: A visually distinctive set of enclosed study spaces for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly lists the Fishbowl Study Spaces among the features on Level 2 of the transformed Kennedy Library.
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 2; verify current availability and any reservation requirement before relying on a room.

cards.entity_name: Jay and Carol Devore Study Room
cards.title: Focus in the Devore Study Room
cards.subtitle: A named third-level room inside Kennedy Library
cards.notes: Find this room on Level 3 for a more bounded work setting, and confirm current occupancy or booking rules before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A named library room suited to a contained study session.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly identifies the Jay and Carol Devore Study Room as a Level 3 feature of Kennedy Library.
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 3; consult current library signage or reservation tools for availability and room-use rules.

cards.title: Bring Graduate Work to Level 4
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Library’s designated graduate study room
cards.notes: Graduate students can look for this Level 4 room when they need a designated work area; verify eligibility at the library first.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated room identified specifically for graduate study.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly lists a Graduate Study Room among Kennedy Library’s Level 4 features.
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 4 and designated for graduate study; confirm current eligibility and entry requirements with the library.

cards.title: Build a Digital Project in the Studio
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Library space for data and visualization work
cards.notes: Bring data-heavy or visual coursework here and check the studio’s current service schedule before planning around specialized support.
cards.short_summary: A technology-oriented workspace for digital scholarship and peer-supported projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly’s catalog says the Digital Scholarship Studio provides spaces, advanced data-analysis and visualization software, and peer learning support.
cards.source_title: Library Services | Cal Poly Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: The studio is inside Kennedy Library; confirm current service hours and software or workstation availability before visiting.

cards.title: Take Your Notes into the Sargen Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Library’s landscaped first-level courtyard
cards.notes: Use the courtyard for reading or laptop work in suitable weather, and keep an indoor alternative ready if conditions change.
cards.short_summary: An open-air library setting for study breaks and daylight work.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly identifies the James P. Sargen Courtyard on Level 1, while the academic catalog describes Kennedy Library as having a landscaped courtyard.
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 1; courtyard access may depend on library operations, posted rules, and weather conditions.

cards.title: Plan Structured Work in a Seminar Room
cards.subtitle: First-level rooms within the refreshed Kennedy Library
cards.notes: Consider these rooms for structured academic work, but check current scheduling and access rules before gathering a group there.
cards.short_summary: Purpose-built rooms offering an alternative to open library seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly lists Library Seminar Rooms among the Level 1 features of the transformed Kennedy Library.
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 1; these rooms may be scheduled for instruction, so verify availability before planning a study session.

cards.title: Open Your Books in Chandler Lounge
cards.subtitle: A designated University Union study space
cards.notes: Try this University Union lounge between campus commitments, and check the building’s current access schedule before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located lounge officially designated for student study.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly Academic Advising identifies Chandler Lounge in the University Union as a designated study space on campus.
cards.source_title: Tutoring Resources, Study Session and Supplemental Workshops
cards.access_notes: Located in the University Union; use is subject to current building access, events, and posted lounge rules.

cards.title: Set Up in San Luis Lounge
cards.subtitle: Another designated University Union study setting
cards.notes: Use this named lounge as a library alternative, especially when your day already brings you through the University Union.
cards.short_summary: A separate University Union lounge recognized by Cal Poly as study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly Academic Advising identifies San Luis Lounge in the University Union as a designated study space on campus.
cards.source_title: Tutoring Resources, Study Session and Supplemental Workshops
cards.access_notes: Located in the University Union; confirm current building access and account for scheduled activities that may affect the lounge.
